title: Regional GPU mix exposure & HC allocation sim Q1 2028
summary: Working simulation that maps regional GPU price exposure to monthly run-rate and recommended headcount allocation across engineering, SRE, and Support. Includes three priced scenarios (Base / Low-price compression / High-price shock) and triggering thresholds for contract vs contractor mix.
assumptions: Model serving profile: average seq len 512, median request tokens 250
Traffic shape: 30% NA, 45% EU, 25% APAC by tokens; peak:baseline = 3x
GPU types available: H100 (dense), A100 (stable), L4 (inference-optimized/cheaper)
FTE fully-loaded monthly cost: Eng = $18,000, SRE = $20,000, Support = $9,000
Contractor hourly blended = $90/hr (engineer-equivalent), used for surge capacity
Token-to-GPU-hour mapping: H100 = 120M tokens/hour, A100 = 60M tokens/hour, L4 = 200M tokens/hour (approx)
Price per 1M tokens charged to customers (base): $0.50; sensitivity modeled ±40%
sensitivity_summary: We run a 3x axis sensitivity: (1) customer price per 1M tokens, (2) GPU hourly costs by region, (3) eng staffing mix contractor vs perm. Key observations: (a) at customer price <= $0.35 / 1M tokens global gross margin compresses below target in the Base GPU mix; (b) substituting 20% of H100 hours with L4 in APAC preserves latency objectives for many workloads and reduces monthly GPU spend by ~12%; (c) contractor-heavy surge is cheaper short-term but increases per-token unit cost if sustained beyond 3 months due to management overhead.
breakpoints_and_triggers: Price breach trigger: if realized price_per_1M_tokens falls below $0.40 for 6 consecutive weeks -> initiate 8-week contractor surge cap and pause non-critical hires
GPU-cost shock: if regional hourly GPU price increases by >25% -> move 15% of workloads to lower-cost compatible model variants and enable autoscaled burst on dedicated capacity
Headcount buffer rule: maintain 6 weeks of contractor runway to avoid immediate hiring during small price swings
SLA adjustment: if average latency tail > 250ms after 2 weeks of GPU mix changes, revert to previous mix and open R&D ticket to evaluate model optimizations
key_metrics_for_review: Monthly GPU burn vs committed capacity (delta)
FTE monthly fixed labor cost vs variable contractor spend
Break-even price per 1M tokens under each mix/scenario
Token throughput per GPU-hour by model family
notes: Sheet is intended to be a modeling sandbox for Finance + Infra + Serving runtime leads. Numbers are intentionally rounded; please cross-check with infra billing export before formalizing guidance. Next step: sync with infra team (Ledger export + GPU reservation mix) and product (expected model mix changes for Q1 2028).
